title: ArPoMeme: An Annotated Arabic Multimodal Dataset for Political Ideology and Polarization

bias_targets.methodology: Annotating a multimodal dataset of Arabic political memes categorized by ideological orientation (Leftist, Islamist, Pan-Arabist, and Satirical) to measure polarization dimensions, specifically 'Us-vs-Them' framing, hostility toward out-groups, and explicit calls to action, and subsequently evaluating vision-language models' zero-shot classification performance on these dimensions.
